newsitem.title: USA: Boehm to head Indiana budget office next year.
newsitem.headline: Boehm to head Indiana budget office next year.

text.p: Peggy Boehm will be Indiana's new budget director when Lt. Gov. Frank O'Bannon becomes governor next year, according to a news release from O'Bannon's transition office.

Boehm, the current chairman of the Indiana Board of Tax Commissioners, has previously served as executive director of the Indiana Development Finance Authority and deputy state budget director under former Gov. Robert Orr.
O'Bannon, a Democrat, defeated Indianapolis Mayor Steve Goldsmith in the Nov. 5 gubernatorial election.
